motivation: The natural prompt required the RLM convention FINAL(...), but the frozen scorer passed trace.last_reply directly to a parser that accepts only a bare Python list. This made compliant envelope use appear unparseable.
descriptive_transform: When a reply ends in FINAL(<payload>), score only the trailing payload; otherwise score the original reply unchanged.
interpretation: The frozen parseability and reward-informativeness counts are interface-confounded and must not be presented as clean model-capability or semantic-flatness results. The terminal decision is nevertheless invariant: even under the favorable envelope sensitivity, parseability and verbatim counts remain below 29/32, descriptive informative groups remain 0/8, and spontaneous child targets remain 0/32.
